name: retroshelf
summary: Records Knulli play sessions and syncs them to your retroshelf account.

notes: Requires a retroshelf account and Wi-Fi for linking and syncing. Upstream documents offline session queuing and a game-session hook installed on first launch.

Review on 2026-10-24 verified the version-pinned Knulli v0.5.6 ZIP against the publisher checksums.txt and GitHub asset digest: 19393643 compressed bytes, 41864615 regular-file bytes, SHA-256 bb60de30f256e9f187e755b2cc84b6df2ffb6b5d04a2be63f8421fdbec18c8bb. All eight files and four directories were inspected; no packaged code was executed. Pinned release metadata does not enable installation.

The packaged launcher applies staged updates and can execute a staged sync engine. Store-managed updates must remain within the Store's pinned checksum and transaction controls; these paths need review and disabling before installation can be enabled.

A redistributable license has not been verified. The public release repository links to a source repository that returned HTTP 404 during review. ELF inspection establishes AArch64 and a glibc 2.17 symbol floor for the UI; the sync engine has no dynamic NEEDED entries. Actual device loading, write containment, preserved credentials and session data, hook ownership, and uninstall behavior remain unverified.

Upstream installs under /userdata/roms/tools/retroshelf and records game sessions through hooks under /userdata/system/scripts. Its uninstall instructions require bin/retroshelf-uninstall.sh before deleting the app folder. Safe hook cleanup and data preservation need lifecycle review; no device compatibility or lifecycle results are claimed.

evidence.note: Documents account linking, offline queuing, Tools installation, session hooks, and uninstall order. Device support is an upstream claim, not Store device-test evidence.
Public release repository at the v0.5.6 tag; README links to https://github.com/ruigomeseu/retroshelf, which still returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-24. No license was verified.

Downloaded ZIP matches the GitHub asset size and SHA-256. Launcher inspection found staged-update application, staged-engine execution, and automatic hook repair. Archive integrity alone does not establish runtime safety.

readelf on the downloaded binaries: ELF64 AArch64. UI NEEDED: SDL2, SDL2_image, SDL2_ttf, SDL2_gfx, libpthread, libresolv, libc; highest GLIBC symbol 2.17. Only SDL2_gfx is bundled. Sync engine has no dynamic NEEDED entries. Static inspection is not proof of device runtime compatibility.
